mechanism: kernels.transition.select / kernels.transition.transition / transition_autograd / pack / admits / rows_for_kit The sealed sm_90a unit loads through its own (torch, CUDA, python tag) loader first; on another interpreter ABI the face loads flash_prebuilt/<flash_abi_key()>/ (built by build_flash_prebuilt.py from the sealed csrc: source digests must equal the sealed manifest's; binary digest, symbols and the SiLU table are checked) and packs the kernel operands from the canonical Weights itself (no parameter version counters: serves under torch.inference_mode). The statement's SiLU*b form keys the cells: select(form='swiglu'|'liger'); the Liger form (silu of fp32 a times fp32 b, one rounding) is served exact-class by the row word v1:liger (the v1 kernel with the Liger kernel's own Triton epilogue statements) and measured in '+liger' cells; the plain form's cells and words are unchanged. No row tunes or builds at run time where measured: af3_fused launches the ONE tile of TRANSITION_CELLS.json launch_pins per (cc, dtype, rows bucket, c, hidden, residual) (the carried autotuner only under the bench env word or on a card without pins); every row's first-call seconds (cold / warm triton cache) are recorded in first_call. Row esm_fused_exact imports .esm_fused lazily (torch + triton at that module's import); its operand pack is built once per Weights (pack_for('esm_fused')). The exact tier word is stack- and size-gated: a kernel exact arm serves only on a stack in the cell's vouched_on and from coverage[family].exact_floor[stack] tokens up, else select('exact') refuses by name with the module floor. Size sweeps per stack set the floors (cc 9.0: 20 tokens; cc 8.0: 64 / 48) and vouch further stacks (vouch-only stacks are served with the reference stack's timings); cc 8.0 af3_fused pins are the fastest tile of a deterministic per-key sweep. Every operand pack is cached on its Weights instance (weight identity; multi-weight replay gate passed on four images); cells are token-keyed (pair rows = N^2 inside the cell) with cc 9.0 pair cells to 2048 tokens. Row af3_fused refuses keys without a launch pin by name (never a live autotune).
